strategic_goal: Raise Literary OS from narrative state/control and realization governance into a model-agnostic higher-order showrunner system that can discover, generate, simulate, rank and integrate diverse new events grounded in character state, relationship state, social institutions, environment and externally researched reality mechanisms.
non_goals: copying existing drama plots or identifiable anecdotes
replacing DB59 authority before DB64 requalification
cancelling preregistered I4J J1 without explicit preoutput governance change
Production or Formal promotion from design documents

relationship_to_current_i4j.rule: I4K Phase 0 may proceed in parallel during runtime outage. When runtime is healthy, resume and close I4J J1 first unless an explicit governance amendment changes ordering before any I4J fresh output. I4K causal execution requires its own fresh preregistration.

external_search_policy.forbidden_primary_use: Search for ready-made drama plots and copy them into generation
external_search_policy.required_transformation: Source fact/workflow -> abstract mechanism -> Event Primitive -> perspective expansion -> event candidate

governance_dependencies: A2 causal adoption and provenance/semantic invariance
phase0_exit_requirements: external literature/research survey completed with source receipts
I4K-1 hypotheses/control/treatment/sample/pass gates preregistered before any candidate generation
